[heading][b]Changelog[/b][/heading]Moiiii

Turns the player character into a furry! Best used with Anthro Characters Continued. Supports Stardew Valley 1.5. Usable only with
Content Patcher at this time. This mod has no other mod dependencies.

This is a fix for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7618]Anthro Farmer Continued Mod[/url]
Which is a continuation of this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2561]Anthro Farmer Continued Mod[/url]﻿

Hopefully this is the last version of this.

[b][size=4]Bugs fixed by this mod[/size][/b][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][list]
[*]Not compatible with active [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url]﻿. Faces are the normal humanlike versions.
[*]Mod crashed when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3642]Event Repeater[/url]﻿ (600k downloads) is installed.
[*]Update key is missing.
[/list]
